text: dsh-network-settings 是面向 DSH 的网络设置插件，通过 dsh-loader 配置页面注册设置，并包装全局 fetch。它可改写出站请求的 User-Agent，使用 HTTP CONNECT 或 SOCKS5 代理并按 NO_PROXY 规则直连，也可对网络错误及部分 HTTP 状态自动重试。配置还包括代理认证、超时和连通性探测，修改后应用于后续请求。适合需要统一调整 DSH 网络请求行为的使用场景；需要 dsh-loader 2.0 和 Node.js 24.9 或更新版本，可选填写代理地址与凭据。

dsh-network-settings configures DSH fetch requests through dsh-loader. It rewrites User-Agent headers, supports HTTP CONNECT or SOCKS5 proxies with NO_PROXY rules, and retries selected failures. Requires dsh-loader 2.0 and Node.js 24.9+.
想给 DSH 的出站请求统一设置 User-Agent。
DSH 怎么通过 SOCKS5 或 HTTP 代理联网？
希望网络失败或遇到限流时，DSH 能自动重试请求。
How can I route DSH fetch requests through my HTTP or SOCKS5 proxy?
I want DSH to retry requests after transient network errors or rate limits.
Can I set a consistent User-Agent for requests made by DSH?
dsh-network-settings 的功能「User-Agent 改写」：开启后把全局 fetch 请求的 User-Agent 设为配置值，保留其他请求选项。可在设置表单修改。
dsh-network-settings 的功能「代理转发」：为全局 fetch 配置 HTTP CONNECT 或 SOCKS5 代理，并可设置认证、超时及 NO_PROXY 直连规则。
dsh-network-settings retries selected fetch failures up to a configured limit, with backoff.
dsh-network-settings 使用前须知：启用代理后，出站请求会经配置的代理主机转发；代理连通性探测默认请求 www.gstatic.com 的 generate_204 地址。代码未要求 API 密钥。

@dsh-plugin/dsh-network-settings README · dsh-network-settings 2.0.0：User-Agent rewriting, HTTP / CONNECT / SOCKS5 proxying, and request retries for dsh. Requires **dsh-loader ^2.0.0** and **Node.js >=24.9.0**.

The loader renders a declarative template as one collapsed Network card with User-Agent, proxy, and retry groups. Save, cancel, and restore-defaults apply to the whole card. Saved changes affect the next outgoing request.

@dsh-plugin/dsh-network-settings README · dsh-network-settings 2.0.0：Before `0.1.6-alpha.2`, open Settings → Plugin configuration. On newer versions, open this plugin's detail page. Configuration lives at `<profile>/config/dsh-network-settings/config.json`; password values stay opaque in browser responses and revision conflicts preserve drafts.

@dsh-plugin/dsh-network-settings README · dsh-network-settings 2.0.0：The proxy supports authentication, NO_PROXY, timeouts, redirects and compressed responses. Retries cover network failures and 429/500/502/503/504; cancellation and non-replayable streams are never retried. Unload releases this plugin's fetch layer while preserving later wrappers.

@dsh-plugin/dsh-network-settings README · dsh-network-settings 2.0.0：The old custom UI and settings write route have been removed. Composition values and the legacy `$DSH_HOME/net-proxy.json` seed defaults; saved profile configuration takes precedence. Old settings namespaces are not moved automatically. Record custom namespace values before upgrading and save them through the new form.

@dsh-plugin/dsh-network-settings README · dsh-network-settings 2.0.0：The authenticated `/_dsh/dsh-network-settings/probe` endpoint remains available (GET health check, POST connectivity probe). Declarative templates have no custom action button, so this version does not include the old custom Test Connection button.

The local development dependency points at the adjacent `../dsh-loader` 2.0 workspace. Build it first, then run `npm install --legacy-peer-deps`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, and `npm pack --dry-run` here.
